description: Atlas issuance-layer conformance vectors. These test the Issuance Authority (M2): scope attenuation (strict subset, now equal-scope allowed), per-principal permissions, and server modes (open, strict, sandbox). Each vector carries an issuance request and the expected outcome (Issued/Refused with cause).

vectors.name: proper-subset-succeeds
vectors.description: A principal with permissions {a, b, c} delegates scope {a, b}. This is a proper subset and should succeed.

vectors.name: equal-scope-succeeds
vectors.description: A principal with permissions {a, b, c} delegates scope {a, b, c} (equal to full set). After D2 fix, equal scope is allowed.

vectors.name: over-scope-refused
vectors.description: A principal with permissions {a, b, c} delegates scope {a, b, c, d}. Scope exceeds permissions, must be refused with OverScope.

vectors.name: permission-unavailable-refused
vectors.description: A principal not in the permissions file attempts to delegate. Must be refused with PermissionsUnavailable.

vectors.name: per-principal-different-permissions
vectors.description: Principal A has {a, b}, Principal B has {c, d}. A delegates {a} (succeeds), B delegates {c} (succeeds), A delegates {c} (fails - not in A's permissions).

vectors.name: strict-mode-principal-missing-refused
vectors.description: In strict mode, a principal not in the permissions file is refused with PermissionsUnavailable.

vectors.name: strict-mode-known-principal-succeeds
vectors.description: In strict mode, a principal in the permissions file can delegate within their permissions.

vectors.name: sandbox-mode-self-delegation-succeeds
vectors.description: In sandbox mode, a principal can delegate to itself (same SPIFFE ID).

vectors.name: sandbox-mode-cross-delegation-refused
vectors.description: In sandbox mode, a principal cannot delegate to a different principal.

vectors.name: empty-scope-refused
vectors.description: An empty scope is malformed and must be refused with MalformedRequest.

vectors.name: missing-principal-refused
vectors.description: A missing principal SPIFFE ID is malformed and must be refused with MalformedRequest.

vectors.name: missing-delegate-refused
vectors.description: A missing delegate SPIFFE ID is malformed and must be refused with MalformedRequest.

vectors.name: scope-with-empty-entry-refused
vectors.description: A scope containing an empty string entry is malformed and must be refused with MalformedRequest.

vectors.name: duplicate-permissions-ignored
vectors.description: Duplicate permissions in the permission set are ignored (set semantics). Principal has {a, a, b} which equals {a, b}. Delegate scope {a, b} succeeds.
